description: TEX, 2005 June regular phase: 50 of 50 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 50 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 50 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20241228114108: 50 listed, 50 matched to MLB's picks by name (9 by surname in the same round: #19 MLB "John Mayberry Jr." / "John Mayberry"; #219 MLB "Jacob Rasner" / "Jake Rasner"; #279 MLB "Ronnie Anderson" / "R.J. Anderson"; #429 MLB "Steven Murphy" / "Steve Murphy"; #609 MLB "Joseph Hooft" / "Joe Hooft"; #669 MLB "Jarrod Dumont" / "Jarod Dumont"; #789 MLB "Benjamin Crabtree" / "Ben Crabtree"; #879 MLB "Phillip Hawke" / "Phil Hawke"; #1119 MLB "Timothy Rodriguez" / "Tim Rodriguez")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
